scope: Três alternativas de concept jovem; propostas, sem substituição do chart, rig ou jogo.

proposals.name: A — Mergulhador de resgate
proposals.detail: A: streamline amphibious QUADRUPED diving rescuer. Replace round child barrel with forward-leaning flexible torpedo-like compact torso; long powerful rear webbed paws and short steering front paws, four limbs total. Low forehead blunt capybara muzzle, determined gentle expression. Child vertical dorsal sail is SUBTRACTED: reorganize it into two low swept hydrofoil folds rooted along the flanks and one short flexible spine ridge; NO giant dorsal sail. Ivory ventral tension-paper surface can cup/support a small rescued creature but depict it empty. Main silhouette is swift horizontal bow, not long sea serpent. Show a bounding low dive preparation with hind legs pushing, near forepaw pulling inward. Soul-tail three tabs flows behind, total length moderate. Key readable feature: rear propulsion versus broad flexible ventral cradle. No armor, weapons, clothes or flotation ring.
proposals.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Soulmonsters original creature evolutionary concept, stage YOUNG (not final adult knight). The attached OWN original Capiboia child sheet is identity reference ONLY; do not reproduce its layout or just enlarge it. Direction 45% living creature,45% functional living kite,10% clean 2D manga/selective stepped dark contour. Crisp economical anime cel drawing, bold confident contour, flat mint, ivory, deep petrol and tiny coral/gold accents, one sharp shadow tone, large quiet color areas. No gradients, airbrush, fur rendering, faceted triangular noise, stitched patch clichés, metallic robots, Digimon or Pokemon designs. Paper is real bodily anatomy: tension membranes, flexible bamboo edge spars, knotted articulations; not a biological animal wearing a kite backpack. Preserve a capybara-derived blunt long muzzle and small rounded ears but evolve proportions to a focused adolescent face with smaller eyes. Palette and ivory flowing cheek/belly motif supply family resemblance. Soul-bearing tail is complete continuous cord from rump with THREE flat diamond tabs and visible knots. ONE creature only, one full-body three-quarter hero pose centered on white with generous margins, no cropped tips, no text, no other mini creatures. Show action through posture, without magic aura or scenery. This is an alternative proposal, not changing approved forms.

proposals.name: B — Contensor de correnteza
proposals.detail: B: low very BROAD quadrupedal current-breaker. Radically wide chest and shoulders, relatively small calm capybara head recessed above prow-like ivory lower-jaw fold, four short robust splayed webbed feet (no human hands). A single continuous thick tension-paper crescent grows from front chest around both flanks as a low flexible breakwater, open behind, visibly part of body not a separate shield held in hand. Bamboo outer edge and two readable tension knots, no cages. Rear torso tapers sharply, no huge tall sail. Show braced oblique pose, near forefoot pushed outward and chest crescent opening against an imaginary current. Deep petrol dominant chest underside, mint upper body ivory crescent coral hinge knots. Soul-tail with three diamond tabs visible behind. Heavy young living animal, not armored adult knight, no helmet, no cannons, no stone turtle shell, no scenery.

proposals.name: C — Condutor de canais
proposals.detail: C: semi-upright light BIPEDAL marsh channel-guide, long springy hind legs with broad webbed feet; two elongated flexible forearms are canoe-paddle shaped tension-paper membranes, clearly rooted at shoulders with one elbow bend and no separate held tools. Four limbs total, two feet on ground and both forelimbs visible. Slender pear-shaped ivory/mint torso, lowered shoulders, long blunt capybara muzzle and modest round ears; adolescent attentive face, no baby smile. Small narrow dorsal folded keel, not giant wings. Show one paddle forearm extended low like a sluice gate and other curved inward redirecting water; a few simple two-tone curved water lines under the extended paddle can clarify the action without hiding feet. Forearm membranes have convex ivory leading edges and dark petrol underside, gold spars following anatomy, not geometric fullbody wireframe. Rabiola three diamond tabs on one continuous cord, hanging behind with clear attachment. The narrative is learning to guide water rather than raw speed or blocking it. No humanoid armor, staff, wizard hat or wings.
